verdict.line: You win short trades and solo kills through the laning phase, but if the game drags without Grievous Wounds, Mundo's sustain claws the matchup back to even.

brief.thesis: Fiora's Duelist passive stacking and Riposte-boosted all-ins give her a real lane and solo-kill edge over Dr. Mundo (53% WR, 166 games), because she can end fights before his Adrenaline Rush passive heals him back. Without Grievous Wounds to shut that regen off, extended skirmishes reset in his favor, which is exactly why the overall matchup shape reads as even despite her lane dominance.

theirWindow.what: Masochism grants him a burst of Attack Damage scaled to missing health for a few seconds on a 7s cooldown. A badly-wounded Mundo is not a free kill in that window — back off or make sure W is up before you commit.

yourWindow.what: Pop W right as you enter melee range so the Attack Damage boost and the auto-parry land on your terms, then chain Q and autos to stack Duelist passive healing through the trade before his per-second regen catches up.

powerCurve.note: Cleaver poke trades, no all-in tools yet

start.why: The highest-picked start (94%, 52.5% WR over 202 games) — the extra sustain absorbs his Infected Cleaver poke while you stack Duelist passive in early trades.

boots.why: Best-performing boots in this matchup (58.6% over 87 games) — flat reduction on his auto-attacks and max-health-scaling Cleaver damage during extended duels.

core.why: Sustains and amplifies your all-in damage output during the level 3-10 window where you hold the edge.
Adds the burst and move speed to close gaps and chain Lunge resets before his passive regen ticks back.
The top-performing full path at 45.9% WR over 37 games — bleed damage and the healing component keep you alive through his retaliatory trades.

situational.when: mundo's passive sustain keeps clawing him back to full between skirmishes
you're significantly ahead and want to end fights before his regen matters
you need extra sustain damage to out-trade his health-scaling burst

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking adaptive damage and healing rewards the extended duels this matchup produces, directly countering his per-second Adrenaline Rush regen in a prolonged fight. Note: master-tier Fiora players (3,777 games) run Press the Attack instead — that fits a more poke-and-disengage style rather than committing to long trades, worth trying if you prefer snappier skirmishes.

summoners.why: The dominant pick (87.9% pick rate, 54.5% WR) — Ignite's damage-over-time and healing reduction cuts directly into his Adrenaline Rush sustain during your all-in windows, stacking with your own Duelist regen advantage.

playing.title: Double-lunge to poke safely
playing.detail: Q (Lunge) can be cast a second time within a couple seconds at no mana cost — use the first to engage and the second to reposition out, racking up Duelist stacks without committing to a full trade.

playing.title: Time W to his auto, not his Cleaver
playing.detail: Riposte only parries his next basic attack, not Infected Cleaver's thrown damage — activate it as you enter melee range so the Attack Damage buff lines up with your actual all-in.

playing.title: Buy Executioner's Calling on sustain stalls
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup: if his passive keeps healing him back between fights, grab it early — Grievous Wounds is what actually ends the stalemate.

playing.title: Respect low-HP Masochism spikes
playing.detail: Below roughly 30% HP his E grants a large missing-health AD burst for several seconds — don't tunnel a 'free kill' without your own HP cushion or W ready.

playing.title: All-in before his level 6 Sadism
playing.detail: Look for solo kills in the 3-5 window with Q+W+E — he has no hard escape until R, and even then it's a speed/regen cooldown, not an untargetable dodge.

playing.title: Don't dump R into a healing target
playing.detail: Blade Waltz deals less on successive hits to the same target, so save it for a burst window with Grievous Wounds active rather than feeding it into his regen.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and every win-rate/sample figure above come from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own analysis, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Focus on getting [P] when fighting Dr. Mundo. Purchase Executioner’s Calling quickly to apply pressure.
